interface.longDescription: Find the article you need in a law or regulation from Spain (España). Search headings or full text inside a consolidated BOE law using its verified identifier. Get matching article or block identifiers, available version details, excerpts and original links. Useful for checking wording and locating the provisions to read. Comparing changes or applicability requires the relevant texts and additional review. The connector searches within a named law; it does not find every law from a topic, determine legal compliance or set up alerts.
